propositions: code-review verdicts never populate the provider_provenance key, unlike plan-review and completion verdicts which record it after story 343b
the verdict assembly in finalize.py sets only cfg-derived fields (runner, model) and never threads through the provenance record from the Pass-2 verify agent step
the sidecar payload builder reads provider_provenance from verdicts but receives None for all code-review gates, creating misattribution when endpoints use Bedrock or OpenAI-compatible gateways
the fix must wire provider_provenance from code-review.yaml's verify agent step (whose outputs are the runner result verbatim) through workflow_ops and finalize without recomputing the record
the degraded/outage verdict path must omit the key rather than synthesizing one from cfg, preserving the truthfulness constraint that provenance exists to enforce
